Bucket.description: What a perturbation is expected to do to a correct agent.
Bucket.title: Bucket

CommandSpec.description:
An agent that is any subprocess. Its tools must go through the MCP boundary.

`argv` may use the placeholders {mcp_config}, {task_file}, {workdir} and {seed}; they are
expanded only at launch and never stored expanded, so sealed records stay path-free.
Exit status 0 means the agent claims success. Anything else is a crash.
CommandSpec.title: CommandSpec

ContractSpec.description: Behaviour contract. Only invariants the tool boundary can observe are allowed.
ContractSpec.title: ContractSpec

DecisionSpec.description:
A System One decision endpoint (TypeSafe's `POST /v1/systemone`) for command agents.

The boundary process serves it on loopback and the agent is pointed at it through
`TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` (a per-trial token, never the real key), so an agent
using the official SDKs needs no code change. Every attempt the agent makes is recorded under
the reserved tool name `decision:systemone`, budgeted, perturbable and replayable exactly like
a tool call. `upstream` says where live answers come from: a trusted `fixture` function
`(request, seed, occurrence) -> response body` imported in the boundary, or `http`, forwarded
verbatim (with `model` pinned) to `base_url` with the real key taken from the HARNESS
environment. Real upstream failures are harness faults (ERROR), never agent failures.
DecisionSpec.title: DecisionSpec

DescriptorCondition.description:
One condition, compiled to a `Condition`.

Give exactly one of `id` and `condition_id` (the same key). Give at most one of `fault` (one
mapping) and `faults` (a list, applied in order); a clean condition gives neither.

condition_id.description: Condition name; alias `id`; exactly one of the two.
condition_id.title: Condition Id

fault.description: One fault; shorthand for a one-element `faults`; not with `faults`.

faults.description: Faults applied together, in order; not with `fault`.
faults.title: Faults

id.description: Alias of `condition_id`; exactly one of the two.
id.title: Id

DescriptorCondition.title: DescriptorCondition

DescriptorFault.description:
One injected fault, compiled to a `FaultSpec`.

Shorthands: `bucket` may be omitted (it means `falsify`); `occurrence` is an alias of
`at_occurrence`, and the two may not both be given, even with equal values. Decision faults
(`decision_low_confidence`, `decision_unavailable`) need top-level `decisions` and
`tool: decision:systemone`; `decision_low_confidence` accepts only the param `confidence_max`
(a number in [0, 1]) and `decision_unavailable` accepts none.

bucket.description: falsify (default): a robust agent should still succeed; benign: must not change the outcome; ceiling: known unrecoverable, reported and never gated.

name.description: A built-in fault (decision_low_confidence, decision_unavailable, empty_result, tool_error_once, tool_timeout) or a custom factory `module:function` (checked for syntax only; imported in the trial process).
name.title: Name

occurrence.description: Alias of `at_occurrence` (give one, not both). Zero-based call count of `tool`; null means the fault's default.
occurrence.title: Occurrence

tool.description: Tool to target; null means any tool.
tool.title: Tool

DescriptorFault.title: DescriptorFault

McpServerSpec.description:
The environment, as ONE stdio MCP server owned by the harness, never by the agent.

Supported subset (protocol revision 2026-07-28, stdio transport): initialize,
notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list and SERIAL tools/call with `resultType`
"complete". Anything else the boundary cannot faithfully record or replay (task results,
sampling, elicitation, concurrent calls) is a harness fault, not a silent pass-through.
`argv` may use {workdir}, {seed} and {task_file}; the server also gets ARCI_WORKDIR,
ARCI_SEED and ARCI_TASK_FILE in its environment.
McpServerSpec.title: McpServerSpec

description:
An ARCI experiment (`arci.yaml`), compiled into a sealed `Manifest` before any trial runs.

Keys are the Manifest's field names. Shorthands: top-level `oracle` stands for
`contract: {oracle: ...}` (give exactly one of `oracle` and `contract`); an arm may be a bare
`module:function`; a condition may use `id` for `condition_id` and `fault` for a one-element
`faults`; a fault may use `occurrence` for `at_occurrence` and omit `bucket` (falsify). An
alias and its full key may never both be given. Unknown keys are errors everywhere, including
`schema_version`, `record_sha256` and `created_at`, which the loader and sealer own. Python
experiments need `toolset` and no `mcp_server`; command experiments need `mcp_server` and no
`toolset`; `decisions` needs command arms. Placeholders such as `{workdir}` stay literal.
This schema cannot express the cross-field rules; the pydantic models are authoritative.

base_seed.description: Seed from which every trial seed derives.
base_seed.title: Base Seed

baseline.description: A python agent as a bare `module:function` string (label `<last module segment>.<function>`, empty candidate_id), or a mapping with `label`, exactly one of `agent` (module:function) or `command` (a CommandSpec), and optional `candidate_id`. Both arms are python agents (top-level `toolset`, no `mcp_server`) or both commands (`mcp_server`, no `toolset`).
baseline.title: Baseline

candidate.description: A python agent as a bare `module:function` string (label `<last module segment>.<function>`, empty candidate_id), or a mapping with `label`, exactly one of `agent` (module:function) or `command` (a CommandSpec), and optional `candidate_id`. Both arms are python agents (top-level `toolset`, no `mcp_server`) or both commands (`mcp_server`, no `toolset`).
candidate.title: Candidate

conditions.description: At least one condition; each runs n_per_arm pairs.
conditions.title: Conditions

contract.description: The behaviour contract, including its `oracle`; give exactly one of `oracle` and `contract`. A non-empty `unobservable` is rejected.

decisions.description: Command experiments only: a System One decision endpoint. A `fixture` is required exactly when upstream is `fixture`.

delta.description: Largest tolerated drop in success rate.
delta.title: Delta

experiment_id.description: Names the experiment and its run directory.
experiment_id.title: Experiment Id

fixtures_sha256.description: Opaque value sealed into the manifest; never computed.
fixtures_sha256.title: Fixtures Sha256

interval_method.description: How the bounds on the rate difference are formed.
interval_method.title: Interval Method

looks.description: Group-sequential looks: strictly increasing, the last equal to n_per_arm; empty means one look at n_per_arm.
looks.title: Looks

mcp_server.description: Command experiments: the environment as one stdio MCP server. Not with `toolset`.

oracle.description: Shorthand for `contract: {oracle: ...}`; give exactly one of `oracle` and `contract`.
oracle.title: Oracle

prior_runs.description: Every earlier experiment on the same candidate_id.
prior_runs.title: Prior Runs

task.description: The task handed to every trial (any JSON object).
task.title: Task

task_id.description: Task name; omitted or null means the experiment_id.
task_id.title: Task Id

toolset.description: Python experiments: `module:function` (task, seed) -> object with `.tools` and `.snapshot()`. Not with `mcp_server`.
toolset.title: Toolset

title: ARCI experiment descriptor
